title: 7-Segment Display
description: Interactive simulation demonstrating how 7-segment displays work to show digits 0-9 using colored LED segments
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: 7-Segment Display
Digital Electronics
LED Display
Binary States
Computer Hardware
Electronics
learningObjectives: Identify the seven segments labeled a through g by their positions in the figure-8 arrangement
Predict which segments must be ON to render a given digit 0-9 before checking the segment status panel
Explain how each segment acts as an independent binary on/off element, so seven bits encode any digit
Compare the segment patterns for visually similar digits such as 6 and 8 or 3 and 9 to find the distinguishing segments
Trace how the digit slider value indexes a segment lookup table that drives the seven ON/OFF states
